title: Proximity Principle
equation: Personal Expansion = Environment Quality × Repeated Exposure × Belief Shift
hook: If everyone around you plays small, small starts to feel normal.
statement: Your environment shapes what feels possible, so spend time around people and rooms that raise your standards.
explainer: Your surroundings train your expectations. Spend time with people building bigger things and what feels possible slowly shifts. Spend it with people playing it safe and safe becomes the ceiling.
sop: Name the level you want to grow into.
Find people and rooms where that level is normal.
Notice how your beliefs start shifting.
Bring those new standards into your daily work.
equation_example: Environment Quality 8, Repeated Exposure 5, Belief Shift 6. 8 × 5 × 6 = 240 Personal Expansion, out of 1,000. Higher means your environment is raising your ceiling. Lower means your surroundings are quietly confirming your limits.
question: Name one room or relationship that would stretch what you believe is possible, and how you'll get in.
closing_statement: Your environment sets your default ceiling.
caption:
Principle Nº 267: Proximity Principle
